senses.gloss: f.(b. h.; תָּפַל) [mud, slime,] frivolity, trivial cause; impropriety, indecency.
units: <cite ref="Avodah Zarah 63b:12">Ab. Zar. 63ᵇ</cite> (in Chald. dict.) <he>כל למעוטי תי׳ שפיר דמי</he> anything to diminish folly (idolatry) is right.

<cite ref="Avodah Zarah 64a:4">Ib. 64ᵃ</cite> <he>ואלו למעט את הת׳ שפיר דמי</he> Ms. M. (ed. <he>ואלו למעוטי ת׳ שרי</he>) but in this case, as it serves to diminish folly (the sin of <cite ref="K00674"><he>כִּלְאַיִם</he></cite>), it is right.
<cite ref="Tosefta Sotah 6:8">Tosef. Sot. VI, 8</cite> <he>אי אפשר לעמוד על תִּיפְלָתָם</he> Var. (ed. Zuck. <he>התָּפֵל</he>) it is impossible to understand their frivolous ways; a. e.—

Lam. R. to II, 14 נאמר בנביאי שומרון ת׳ … ירושלים ת׳ of the prophets of Samaria the word tiflah is used (Jer. XXIII, 13) …, and of the prophets of Jerusalem the word tiflah (tafel) is used (Lam. l. c.).
